description: Research-priority tiers for the single-stock valuation universe. Tiers allocate research effort; they never authorize capital.

governance.owner_override_precedence: owner overrides replace the automatically assigned tier but retain observed automatic signals for auditability

tier_1.label: Active capital decision
tier_1.research_depth: full stock-specific model, primary-source evidence, adversarial review, and explicit refresh cadence
promotion_gates: A positive active position, active committee, open material trigger, current or expired owner decision, or approved target allocation exists.
A stock-specific model and complete evidence gates are still required before committee review.
Only a recorded human decision may authorize capital or sizing.
demotion_conditions: No positive position, active committee, open trigger, current or expired owner decision, or approved target allocation remains.
The owner explicitly overrides the name to a lower tier.

tier_2.label: Curated research queue
tier_2.research_depth: focused evidence closure and stock-specific model development before any committee work
promotion_gates: Promote when a positive position, active committee, open material trigger, current or expired owner decision, or approved target allocation appears.
An owner override may promote the name with a documented reason and review date.
demotion_conditions: No validation follow-up, watchlist membership, priority stance, or proposed target allocation remains.
The owner explicitly overrides the name to Tier 3.

tier_3.label: Broad screening universe
tier_3.research_depth: automated screening and lightweight monitoring only
promotion_gates: Promote to Tier 2 when a curated follow-up, watchlist entry, priority stance, or proposed target allocation appears.
Promote to Tier 1 only through a Tier 1 qualifying signal or documented owner override.
demotion_conditions: Remove from the valuation universe only through an explicit universe-governance change; absence of a model is not a deletion signal.
